### 几段Latex的例子

```
\documentclass[a4paper,10pt]{article}

\usepackage[nocjkgb]{ucs}
\usepackage[utf8x]{inputenc}
\usepackage[C10,T1]{fontenc}
\newcommand\chinesesimptext[1]{\bgroup\fontencoding{C10}\fontfamily{song}\selectfont\SetUnicodeOption{cjkgb}#1\egroup}
%opening
\title{\chinesesimptext{陈忠克的文档}}
\author{\chinesesimptext{陈忠克}}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\begin{abstract}
\chinesesimptext{摘要}
\end{abstract}

\paragraph{段落}
\chinesesimptext{中文}
\chinesesimptext{中文}

\end{document}
```

```
\documentclass{article}
\usepackage{CJK}

\begin{document}
\begin{CJK*}{GBK}{song}
\title{输入输出}
\author{czk}
\maketitle
\section{C语言}
\subsection{scanf}
\subsection{getchar}
\subsection{gets}
\subsection{fgets}
\subsection{printf}
\subsection{puts}
\subsection{putchar}
\section{C++语言}
\subsection{cin}
\subsection{cout}
\section{例子}
\subsection{遇到特定标志结束输入}
\begin{verbatim}
while( 1 ) {
   scanf("%d", &n);
   if( n == 0) break;
   // your algorithm goes here
}
\end{verbatim}

\begin{verbatim}
while(1) {
   cin >> n;
   if( n == 0) break;
}
\end{verbatim}
\subsection{遇到EOF结束输入}
\begin{verbatim}
while(1) {
   if( scanf("%d", &n) == EOF ) break;
   // your algorithm goes here
}
\end{verbatim}
\begin{verbatim}
while(1) {
   int c = getchar();
   if(c==EOF) break;
}
\end{verbatim}
\begin{verbatim}
while(cin>>n) {
   // your algorithm goes here
}
\end{verbatim}
\begin{verbatim}
while(1) {
   cin >> n >> m;
   if(cin.eof()) break;
}
\end{verbatim}
\end{CJK*}
\end{document}
```
